verdict.rationale: First-party docs say skills "build on the open agent skills standard." They use the standard SKILL.md folder format with required `name`/`description` frontmatter, discovered from the vendor-neutral `.agents/skills` path. A hands-on probe confirmed portability: a third-party `npx skills add` tool installed an OpenAI catalog skill as a plain, valid SKILL.md folder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of which spec version is followed and whether Codex adds vendor-specific extensions ("build on" rather than strict conformance), and independent proof of the same skill folder actually executing in a non-OpenAI agent.
